verdicts.note: -2 is the maximal proven-record case (long tenure, enacted record). Cathcart is a two-term city councilmember (since 2019) seeking a different, open office [S1][S3][S8]. That is the same profile the package scores -1 elsewhere: Schmidt, a two-term legislator with eight enacted bills running for an open commission seat, and the four non-incumbent judicial candidates. Only the sitting officeholder (McCollam) gets -2. The direction is clear against a 24-year-old first-time candidate; the full pole is not.
